name: Autotekst
tagline: University of Oslo's own web service that turns uploaded audio and video into text and subtitles, using Whisper speech models run on UiO servers

vendor_entity.value: Universitetet i Oslo (University of Oslo), IT Department (USIT)

retention_stated.footnote: AutotekstVMS (Panopto): video copies deleted after captioning (at most one month on errors), captions deleted after 1 month.
retention_stated.note: Uploaded audio is deleted right after transcription; transcripts after 12 months. The older Norwegian terms page (2023) still says uploaded files are kept up to 1 year.

deletion_on_exit.note: The contract template says UiO will help transfer the customer's data at termination, but gives no deletion step or time frame. The DPA could not be read (source blocked: https://nettskjema.no/a/databehandleravtale-autotekst). Transcripts are auto-deleted after 12 months anyway.

evidence.quote: it can be easily downloaded in the formats TXT, SRT or WEBVTT

data_export.note: Transcripts download as TXT, SRT or WebVTT. The contract template also promises reasonable help transferring customer data at termination.

breach_notice.note: No breach-notification window in the contract template or service pages. The DPA could not be read (source blocked: https://nettskjema.no/a/databehandleravtale-autotekst).

evidence.quote: Partenes rettigheter og plikter etter denne Avtalen bestemmes i sin helhet av norsk rett.

governing_law.note: Norwegian law. The template's chosen dispute route is the Ministry of Education (Kunnskapsdepartementet).

evidence.quote: Autotekst is a UiO-developed service for transcribing speech to text using Whisper from OpenAI.
Tjenesten tilbyr de funksjoner, språk og filformater som er tilgjengelige i løsningen Whisper fra OpenAi og tjenesten kjører internt på UiOs serverrom.
You can choose between NB Whisper, NB Whisper verbatim, OpenAI Whisper V3, or OpenAI Whisper V2.
Ny modell tilgjengelig; KBLab-Whisper. Denne er trent ved Sveriges nasjonalbibliotek på data fra bibliotekets samlinger.

ai_providers.note: Openly published speech models run on UiO servers: OpenAI Whisper V2/V3, NB-Whisper (National Library of Norway), KBLab-Whisper (National Library of Sweden), with WhisperX for timing and speaker separation. No content goes to OpenAI or the libraries: 'no data leaves UiO's infrastructure'.

trains_on_content.note: No Autotekst page or the contract template says whether uploaded audio or transcripts are used to train or tune models. Uploaded audio is deleted right after transcription and UiO acts as processor. The UiO-wide IDEA statement about agreements with Google, OpenAI and Microsoft is about those external companies, not about Autotekst.

evidence.quote: The entire service runs on UiO’s servers, and no data leaves UiO’s infrastructure.

ai_zero_retention.note: No external model provider receives content, so there is no provider-side retention to state. UiO's own retention is under retention_stated.

ai_admin_off.note: Transcription is the whole service, so there is no AI toggle. Institutions must enable Autotekst in their Feide customer portal, which controls access to the service as a whole.

ai_act_statement.note: No EU AI Act statement on the Autotekst, bestill, AutotekstVMS or terms pages. The AutotekstVMS page has a short note that AI models make errors.

certifications.note: No certification named on the Autotekst, bestill, AutotekstVMS, terms, contract template or UiO privacy pages. The bestill page offers access to risk assessments (ROS-analyser).

trust_page.note: No separate security or trust centre. The bestill page has a short 'Personvern og sikkerhet' section.

encryption.note: Encryption is not described. The contract template only commits to measures 'alminnelig anerkjente i bransjen' for confidentiality.

pentest.note: No penetration test statement found. Risk assessments (ROS-analyser) are offered to customers, which is not a pentest.

vuln_disclosure.note: security.txt returned 404 on www.uio.no, www.usit.uio.no and autotekst.uio.no (cached).

incidents.note: Web search for Datatilsynet decisions on UiO/Autotekst found no regulator decision or UiO notice about Autotekst.

status_page.note: No public status page found. The contract template says planned downtime is announced in the application.

sso.note: Login is through Feide or Educloud (TSD version: TSD username and password). The protocol is not named on the pages read.

evidence.quote: Log in with Feide
Deretter må institusjonen ha åpnet for bruk av Autotekst.uio.no i sin Feide-kunde-portal

wcag_level.note: The app footer links a Norwegian-only accessibility statement, but its URL could not be found (not on autotekst.uio.no links or a search of uustatus.no), so the claimed level was not read.
